messages.author: 185b691c84b200d6
messages.subject: Shiny Server 0.5.0 vs 0.4.0
parts:
Dear all,
 
I just installed (on Ubuntu 12.04 64 bit) according to the installation guide Shiny Server. It works nicely. Rstudio has done a great job!
But.....
I have installed through "wget http://download3.rstudio.org/ubuntu-12.04/x86_64/shiny-server-0.4.0.15-amd64.deb" version 0.4.0, which is not the latest release.
 
So questions came up:
1. Where do I find a change log to judge if I should update the package just before getting productive with my web applications?
2. Might the update impact (in a positive way) my difficulties with IE 9 in our cooperate environment. IE 9 does not fill e.g. selectInput... Firefox (portable) does... (please see the screen shot for IE 9 attached)
 
Thank you very much for any hint
 
Jürgen

messages.author: 185b691c84b200d6
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Server 0.5.0 vs 0.4.0
parts:
Dear all,
 
my major problem that the shiny app was not properly rendered in IE 9 is linked to the type of compatibility IE has "choosen". In my case a switch to IE 9 (and not compatibility modus IE 7 or IE 8) has done the job. 
 
Best regards,
 
Jürgen
 
PS. By the way... I am still interested in a change log link for the various shiny server versions.
